Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Gould Contemporary Wood Bedside Nightstand Table, 16", Washed Navy and Gold
Colors: Washed Navy
Materials: stone
26"L x 16"W x 26"H Engineered birch wood Sophisticated modern style Two drawers for optimal storage Assemble in 30 minutes-1 hour with two people Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty This 2-drawer nightstand is as big on style as it is on storage. The washed navy finish will give your room the perfect pop of color. Elaborate gold hardware and a felt lined top drawer round out the feel of glamour and luxury.
